systems.platform: IASO (Bluesquare), Android mobile app with offline capture and a web instance
systems.owner: PNECHOL-MD and DSNIS with Bluesquare; funded first by USAID PROSANI (9 provinces), then the Global Fund through SANRU (16 provinces) and the RHCC project (Kasai); server due to migrate to ANICNS
systems.tiers: head nurses of health areas enter supervision and monthly data on community care sites; all 26 provinces; more than 80,000 monthly form submissions as of 10 June 2026
receives regular exports of the monthly variables head nurses upload through the SSC App

note: A community health worker supervision system, noted and not assessed, so no fact. It exchanges data with the national system: the document states that all monthly variables are configured in the DHIS2 community NHIS instance and exported regularly from IASO to DHIS2.
